s=s.replace("""        s.ack = copy.deepcopy(self.ack)

        s.crypto = {k:dict(v) for k,v in self.crypto.items()}""")
s=s.replace("def process_payload(payload, st):","def process_payload(payload, st, level=2):")
s=s.replace("""            low = f['largest']-f['first']
            st.ack = add_iv(st.ack, low, f['largest']+1)""","""            low = f['largest']-f['first']
            st.ack[level] = add_iv(st.ack[level], low, f['largest']+1)""")

"""        for lvl in range(3):
